sentences.text: Finally, the signature itself can change.
A derivor from Sigma to Lambda may even identify sorts, for instance by sending both s and t to a single sort.
It determines generalized H E P derivors between the categorial extensions, in every dimension and in both presentations, and they turn categorial Lambda-algebras into categorial Sigma-algebras.
These functors form split indexed categories over the category of signatures and derivors:
a category of algebras for every signature, and a functor for every derivor, compatible with composition.
Graduation, unification, discretization and truncation all commute with them.
So they are natural transformations between indexed categories, and they extend to the Grothendieck constructions, which gather the algebras of all signatures in a single category.
